#!/bin/bash

# Open Chrome with google.com
google-chrome https://www.google.com &

# Open a text editor (using nano as default; change to your preferred editor)
echo "Opening text editor (nano)..." 
echo "Press Ctrl+X to exit, Ctrl+O to save, Ctrl+Y to confirm save." 
nano &

# Open file manager showing [private-home]/Documents/llama.cpp
nautilus "file://[private-home]/Documents/llama.cpp" &
